quotes.title: WASP-79
quotes.card: WASP-79, also named Montuno, is an F-type main-sequence star about 801 light-years away in the constellation Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 10, it is much too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
